questions.questionText: Which two popular layout modules are used in modern CSS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Flexbox and Grid.

questions.questionText: The CSS Flexible Box Layout Module is also known as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Flexbox.

questions.questionText: Flexbox takes care of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Alignment, layout, and space distribution.

questions.questionText: All items in a flex container are called:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Flex items.

questions.questionText: To make an element a flex container, the display property is set to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) flex.

questions.questionText: The main axis in flexbox is determined by:
options: The direction of the flex items
questions.correctAnswer: The direction of the flex items
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The direction of the flex items.

questions.questionText: The cross axis is always:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Perpendicular to the main axis.

questions.questionText: If the main axis is horizontal, the cross axis is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Vertical.

questions.questionText: Which property defines how flex items are stacked?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) flex-direction.

questions.questionText: Which is NOT a valid flex-direction value?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) column-wrap.

questions.questionText: flex-direction: column stacks items:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Vertically.

questions.questionText: flex-direction: row-reverse arranges items:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Right to left.

questions.questionText: Which property controls whether flex items wrap onto multiple lines?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) flex-wrap.

questions.questionText: Which property sets flex-direction and flex-wrap together?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) flex-flow.

questions.questionText: flex-flow: row wrap sets:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Direction row and wrapping enabled.

questions.questionText: Which property aligns flex items along the main axis?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) justify-content.

questions.questionText: Which justify-content value places items at the end of the container?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) flex-end.

questions.questionText: justify-content: space-between:
options: Places equal space between the items
questions.correctAnswer: Places equal space between the items
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Places equal space between the items.

questions.questionText: justify-content: space-around:
options: Distributes items with equal space around them
questions.correctAnswer: Distributes items with equal space around them
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Distributes items with equal space around them.

questions.questionText: justify-content: space-evenly:
options: Distributes items with equal spacing between and around them
questions.correctAnswer: Distributes items with equal spacing between and around them
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Distributes items with equal spacing between and around them.

questions.questionText: Which property aligns flex items along the cross axis?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) align-items.

questions.questionText: Which is a valid align-items value?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) stretch.

questions.questionText: The align-items value "baseline" aligns items:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) By their text baselines.

questions.questionText: align-content is used to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Align flex lines.

questions.questionText: align-content: stretch:
options: Stretches flex lines to take the remaining space
questions.correctAnswer: Stretches flex lines to take the remaining space
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Stretches flex lines to take the remaining space.

questions.questionText: Which property helps a flex item grow relative to the others?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) flex-grow.

questions.questionText: flex-grow takes a:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Number value.

questions.questionText: Which property helps a flex item shrink?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) flex-shrink.

questions.questionText: Setting flex-shrink to 0 means the item:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Will not shrink.

questions.questionText: The flex shorthand property specifies:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) flex-grow, flex-shrink, and flex-basis.

questions.questionText: Which property overrides align-items for an individual flex item?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) align-self.

questions.questionText: flex-basis specifies:
options: The initial size of a flex item
questions.correctAnswer: The initial size of a flex item
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The initial size of a flex item.

questions.questionText: A CSS grid layout has:
options: One parent element with one or more child elements
questions.correctAnswer: One parent element with one or more child elements
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) One parent element with one or more child elements.

questions.questionText: Child elements of a grid container are called:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Grid items.

questions.questionText: To make an element a grid container, set display to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) grid or inline-grid.

questions.questionText: Display: inline-grid generates:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) An inline-level grid.

questions.questionText: Grid lines are:
options: The dividing lines that form the structure of the grid
questions.correctAnswer: The dividing lines that form the structure of the grid
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The dividing lines that form the structure of the grid.

questions.questionText: A grid cell is:
options: The single unit of a grid
questions.correctAnswer: The single unit of a grid
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The single unit of a grid.

questions.questionText: A grid track is a generic term for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A grid column or row.

questions.questionText: The space between two adjacent vertical grid lines is a:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Grid column.

questions.questionText: The space between two adjacent horizontal grid lines is a:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Grid row.

questions.questionText: Which property defines the number and width of columns?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) grid-template-columns.

questions.questionText: Which property defines the height of rows?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) grid-template-rows.

questions.questionText: grid-column-gap defines:
options: The size of the gap between columns
questions.correctAnswer: The size of the gap between columns
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The size of the gap between columns.

questions.questionText: grid-row-gap defines:
options: The size of the gap between rows
questions.correctAnswer: The size of the gap between rows
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The size of the gap between rows.

questions.questionText: grid-gap is a shorthand for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) grid-row-gap and grid-column-gap.

questions.questionText: Which grid item property specifies where an item starts and ends in columns?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) grid-column.

questions.questionText: Which grid item property specifies where an item starts and ends in rows?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) grid-row.

questions.questionText: grid-area can be used to:
options: Specify start/end positions or assign names to grid items
questions.correctAnswer: Specify start/end positions or assign names to grid items
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Specify start/end positions or assign names to grid items.

questions.questionText: The justify-content property in a grid aligns the grid:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Horizontally inside the container.

questions.questionText: The align-content property in a grid aligns the grid:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Vertically.

questions.questionText: In a grid, "space-around" gives columns:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Equal space around them.

questions.questionText: Which statement is true about Flexbox vs Grid?
options: Flexbox is mainly one-dimensional while Grid is two-dimensional
questions.correctAnswer: Flexbox is mainly one-dimensional while Grid is two-dimensional
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Flexbox is mainly one-dimensional while Grid is two-dimensional.
